claim: Exact selected results with measurement, reset, classical feedback and rational Pauli channels; no general quantum-computer replacement claim.

protocol.aer_readings: saved expectation values of simulated states, not estimates from one measured output bit
protocol.aer_shots: one local simulator trajectory per exported circuit; Shor syndromes are deterministic and independently checked exactly; corrected teleportation output readings are the same in every branch, checked separately by exact joint queries and forward density branches
protocol.initial_boundary: quantum all-zero and classical all-zero; input preparations are part of each circuit
protocol.limits: term/bit/work guards; conditional predicates and requested joint outcomes can expand exponentially; no polynomial guarantee
protocol.native: complete Pauli times classical Walsh expansion; no trajectory/density/statevector construction; no truncation
protocol.noise: synthetic independent rational X-flip probability 1/10 on each data qubit each round; ideal syndrome operations
protocol.random_crosschecks: unit tests include 32 seeded 1..4-qubit dynamic programs against independent forward unnormalized density branches; joint outcomes, joint moments, overwrite, feedback and rational noise
protocol.round_formula: pL=3*p^2-2*p^3; entanglement fidelity after r corrected rounds = (1+(1-2*pL)^r)/2
protocol.shor: nine data qubits, one reused syndrome ancilla, one external reference; new ideal recovery circuit, not a replay of historical IBM jobs
protocol.timings: descriptive native execution times only; no speed comparison to Aer or quantum hardware in this report
